data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Natallos, meaning 'reborn'. In Christian tradition, the name Natala is associated with the story of Saint Natalia of Cilicia, who was believed to have been reborn after a miraculous healing. The name Natala carries the meaning “Reborn” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Natala usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
